WAR MAGES are characters skilled in the arts of battle magics.Few can match their destructive power.

The War Mage profession contains the Arcane Lore, Healing, Mana Conversion and War Magic skills.

WAYFARERS are versatile adventurers, fighting their way through life with stealth and skill.

The Wayfarer gets the Arcane Lore, Dagger, Crossbow, Healing, Item Enchantment, Lockpick and Melee Defense skills.

LIFE CASTERS are experts in all matters of vital essence.They can both give life and take it away.

The Life Caster profession contains the Creature Enchantment, Life Magic, Mana Conversion and War Magic skills.

BOW HUNTERS are specialists in the use of bows. Few characters can shoot arrows with such lethal precision as a highly trained hunter.

The Bow Hunter profession contains the Arcane Lore, Bow, Item Enchantment and Melee Defense skills
